entries.title: New tasks count the work each subscription already has
entries.body: When choosing a model for a new task, Infinitary now counts the work already running on each subscription, here and on your other computers. It learns how much a task usually uses from your own finished tasks and allowance readings, and changes nothing until it has learned enough. Your allowance meters still show the provider's own readings.
entries.noPicture: This changes model choices behind existing task summaries, not the appearance of a screen.
